    StartersStark mansion canapésCrisp wonton cups with soy and sesame sashimi tuna, smashed avocado and sesameHow to make it16 wonton wrappers1 L vegetable oil250g sashimi tuna1 tbsp soy sauce1 tsp sesame oil1 lime1 spring onion, sliced1 avocado1 tbsp sesame seeds, toastedFry the wonton wrappers at 180°C until crisp. Drain.Dice the tuna and dress with soy, sesame oil, lime juice and spring onion.Smash the avocado.Spoon the tuna onto the wontons and top with a dot of avocado and the sesame.Cave flatbreadYoghurt flatbreads and hummus, from a box of scrapsHow to make it300g plain flour250g Greek yoghurt1 tsp baking powder1 tsp salt50g butter2 garlic cloves, crushed1 tub hummusMix the flour, yoghurt, baking powder and salt to a soft dough.Roll into six thin rounds.Cook in a dry hot pan until blistered, turning once.Brush with butter melted with the garlic and serve with hummus.MainsTony's American cheeseburgerTwo smashed patties with onion, pickles, mustard and ketchup on a toasted bunHow to make it600g beef mince8 slices of American cheese4 burger buns1 onion, diced4 dill pickles2 tbsp yellow mustard2 tbsp tomato saucesalt, to tasteRoll the mince into eight balls and dice the onion.Smash each flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook.Flip, top with cheese and cook a minute more. Toast the buns.Stack two per bun with onion, pickles, mustard and tomato sauce.Pepper Potts' Malibu rib eyePepper's dinner, after the dry cleaningHow to make itAs written, serves 4Dry-brined rib eye seared and butter-basted, rested and sliced with punchy chimichurri and crisp smashed baby potatoes with garlic and rosemary.Salt 4 rib eye steaks and refrigerate uncovered overnight.Boil 1kg baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash flat on an oiled tray and roast at 220°C for 30 minutes with garlic and rosemary.Chop a bunch of parsley, 1 tbsp oregano, 2 garlic cloves and 1 red chilli and mix with 3 tbsp red wine vinegar and 100ml olive oil.Sear the steaks 3 minutes a side, basting with butter, and rest 8 minutes.SweetsArc reactor cupcakesVanilla cupcakes, blue ring. I am Iron Man.How to make it275g butter, soft150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml full cream milk300g icing sugar1 tsp blue food colouringHeat the oven to 180°C and line a 12-hole tin. Beat half the butter with the sugar, then the eggs.Fold in the flour and milk, divide between the cases and bake.Cool completely.Beat the remaining butter with the icing sugar and tint half blue.Pipe a blue ring with a white centre.DrinksTony's workshop scotch penicillinScotch, lemon, honey and ginger with a float of peaty single maltHow to make it3 tbsp honey3 tbsp water1 piece ginger (2 cm), sliced200ml blended Scotch40ml peaty single malt3 lemons4 pieces of candied ginger4 large ice cubes2 cups ice, for shakingSimmer the honey, water and ginger, then strain and cool.Shake the Scotch, lemon juice and the syrup with ice.Strain into four tumblers over one large cube each.Float a little peaty single malt on each and garnish with candied ginger.
